text.title: Product-Led Growth (PLG) Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: inputs → procedure steps → final artefact matching the JSON Schema in 02-output-contract.xml. Then the PLG onboarding pattern and the PostHog PQL scorer reference.

section.title: Inputs (mocked)
section.note: Pulled per `## Prerequisites`; sources cited in `01-core-rules.xml` rationale.

section.title: Step-by-step application
section.note: 1. Preconditions check: all `## Applies If` items satisfied; no `## Skip If` items fired.
2. Inputs gathered from named sources; freshness OK.
4. Artefact produced from `templates/` rendered with real values (see Final Artefact below).

section.title: Final artefact (matches schema)
PLG onboarding pattern

example.title: Onboarding pattern checklist
example.note: Interactive product tours, not documentation pages
Progressive feature disclosure — no feature dump on first session
Contextual tooltips at moment of relevance, not pre-emptive
Personalized onboarding paths by user segment — 3-tour designs consistently beat 1-tour

section.reference: PostHog PQL scorer: weight in-app events, write pql_score + pql_tier back as person properties
